biography.value:
Battle dragons roost on the war-torn slopes of the heroic plane of Ysgard, where fallen warriors rise each dawn to fight again. They prize courage above gold, keep careful tallies of worthy foes, and often spare an enemy who fought well. Their scales are the color of polished bronze, nicked by a thousand duels.

Unofficial 5e conversion of a dragon from an earlier edition of the game, for the Legacy Dragons module.

description.value: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster] can use its [[/item .huOHWZ7pfKSZMOA7]]{Frightful Presence}. It then makes three attacks: one with its [[/item .2rbp8x5oB8G64hHs]]{bite} and two with its [[/item .3slkL7hxPrycb6Ya]]{claws}.
If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

activation.condition: When the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} fails a saving throw.

description.chat: The [[lookup @name]]{monster} slams its long tail against its foe!

description.value: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} beats its wings. Each creature within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=bLVsAvCvmNeAZp0D]] of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} must succeed on a [[/save]] saving throw or take [[/damage average]] damage and be knocked &Reference[prone]. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can then fly up to half its flying speed.

Each creature of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s choice that is within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=8BkiXFB2lQPx8Ymp]] of the dragon and aware of it must succeed on a [[/save]] saving throw or become &Reference[frightened] for [[lookup @labels.duration activity=8BkiXFB2lQPx8Ymp]].

A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s [[lookup @item.name]] for the next 24 hours.
description.chat: Each creature of the [[lookup @name]]{monster}'s choice that is within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=8BkiXFB2lQPx8Ymp]] of the [[lookup @name]]{monster} and aware of it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns.

effects.name: Frightful Presence
effects.description:
You are &reference[frightened apply=false] for 1 minute.

You can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of your turns, ending the effect on yourself on a success. If your saving throw is successful or the effect ends for you, you are immune to the dragon's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

description.value:
The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} uses one of the following breath weapons.

Sonic Breath. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} exhales a thunderclap of sound in a [[lookup @labels.description.template activity=HMiKXqk78KCehAle]]. Each creature in that area must make a [[/save activity=HMiKXqk78KCehAle]] saving throw, taking [[/damage average activity=HMiKXqk78KCehAle]] damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

Daunting Roar. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} unleashes its daunting Roar in a [[lookup @labels.description.template activity=PHtIMqC7h6G9cvR1]]. Each creature in that area must succeed on a [[/save activity=PHtIMqC7h6G9cvR1]] saving throw or be &Reference[frightened] of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has advantage on attack rolls against a creature that attacked it since the end of its last turn.

When the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} challenges a creature to single combat (no action required), it has advantage on saving throws against that creature's effects until one of them drops to 0 hit points or another creature harms either of them.

On initiative count 20 (losing initiative ties), the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} takes a lair action to cause one of the following effects; it can't use the same effect two rounds in a row:

  • Distant war horns sound. Each creature of the dragon's choice within 120 feet must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or have disadvantage on attack rolls until initiative count 20 on the next round.
  • Spectral weapons rise from the ground in a 20-foot-radius sphere the dragon can see within 120 feet. Each creature there must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 10 (3d6) slashing damage.
  • The dragon chooses one creature it can see. Until initiative count 20 on the next round, that creature can't take reactions and other creatures can't help it with the Help action.
